zh.q: 水星白天赤道附近最热能到多少度？
zh.gold: 白天时赤道地区温度可达432°C，夜间可降至-172°C。

zh.q: 第一个给水星表面画出将近一半地图的探测器是哪艘？
zh.gold: 第一艘是1974至1975年的水手10号，只描绘了45%的水星表面图。

zh.q: 金星表面的大气压是地球的多少倍？
zh.gold: 它有着四颗类地行星中最浓厚的大气层，其中超过96%都是二氧化碳，大气压力是地球的92倍。

zh.q: 金星的直径是多少公里？
zh.gold: 它的直径是12,092公里（只比地球少 650公里），质量是地球的81.5%。

zh.q: 原始地球大约是在多少年前形成的？
zh.gold: 根据放射性定年法的测量结果，太阳系大约在45.6±0.08亿年前形成，而原始地球大约形成于45.4±0.04亿年前。

zh.q: 火星绕太阳一圈要多久？
zh.gold: 火星公转周期为1.88地球年(687地球日)，自转周期则约为24小时40分，其公转引起了火星冲日等天文现象。

zh.q: 火星的地壳最厚的地方有多厚？
zh.gold: 火星的地壳平均厚约50公里，最厚可达125公里。

zh.q: 现在还在环绕木星工作的探测器是哪一个？
zh.gold: 目前朱诺号是木星轨道上唯一运作中的探测器，自2016年7月4日进入环绕木星的轨道后便持续进行观测作业至今。

zh.q: 哪颗行星放进水里会浮起来？
zh.gold: 虽然土星核心的密度远高于水，但由于存在较厚的大气层，土星仍是太阳系中唯一密度低于水的行星，它的比重是0.69 公克/公分³。

zh.q: 土星上的风最快有多快？
zh.gold: 土星大气层通常呈现均匀特征，但风速可达每小时1,800公里，为太阳系行星之最。

zh.q: 天王星是谁在哪一年宣布发现的？
zh.gold: 直到1781年3月13日，威廉·赫歇耳爵士宣布发现天王星，从而在太阳系的现代史上首度扩展已知的界限，也是第一颗使用望远镜发现的行星。

zh.q: 哪颗行星是先用数学算出来、再被望远镜找到的？
zh.gold: 海王星于17世纪时已有观测记录，在1846年9月正式被柏林天文台发现，是唯一一颗通过数学计算预测而非实际观测发现的行星。

en.q: How long does one day, sunrise to sunrise, last on Mercury?
en.gold: Consequently, one solar day (sunrise to sunrise) on Mercury lasts for around 176 Earth days, or twice Mercury's sidereal year.

en.q: Which spacecraft made the first successful flyby of Mercury?
en.gold: The first successful flyby of Mercury was conducted by Mariner 10 in 1974, and it has since been visited and explored by the MESSENGER and BepiColombo orbiters.
It has a diameter of 12,103.6 km (7,520.8 mi)—only 638.4 km (396.7 mi) less than Earth's—and its mass is 81.5% of Earth's, making it the third-smallest planet in the Solar System.

en.q: What gas makes up most of Venus's atmosphere?
en.gold: Conditions on the surface of Venus differ radically from those on Earth because its dense atmosphere is 96.5% carbon dioxide, causing an intense greenhouse effect, with most of the remaining 3.5% being nitrogen.

en.q: How much of Earth's crust is covered by ocean?
en.gold: Almost all of Earth's water is contained in its ocean, which covers 70.8% of Earth's crust.

en.q: How long is a year on Mars?
en.gold: A Martian solar year is equal to 1.88 Earth years (687 Earth days), a Martian solar day (sol) is equal to 24.6 hours.

en.q: Which probe first flew past Mars successfully?
en.gold: The first successful flyby exploration of Mars was conducted in 1965 with Mariner 4.

en.q: How many moons does Jupiter have?
en.gold: At least 115 moons orbit the planet; the four largest moons—Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto—orbit within the magnetosphere and are visible with common binoculars.

en.q: Which planet would float in water?
en.gold: Saturn is the only planet of the Solar System that is less dense than water—about 30% less.

en.q: How fast can the wind blow on Saturn?
en.gold: Wind speeds on Saturn can reach 1,800 kilometers per hour (1,100 miles per hour).

en.q: When was Uranus recognised as a planet, and by whom?
en.gold: Uranus is visible to the naked eye, but it is very dim and moves very slowly relative to the background stars and was not classified as a planet until 1781, when it was first observed by William Herschel.

en.q: Which spacecraft is the only one ever to visit Neptune?
en.gold: Voyager 2, which flew by Neptune on 25 August 1989, remains the only spacecraft to visit the planet.
